items.title: Aspire 13.6 Adds Persistent Dashboard Telemetry and First-Party Java and Rust Hosting
items.blurb: Microsoft has released Aspire 13.6. The dashboard now stores telemetry in SQLite and keeps up to ten completed runs per application.

items.title: Cloudflare Fixes Cross-Tenant Data Exposure in Containers
items.blurb: Cloudflare has disclosed a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability in Containers and Sandboxes, caused by thin-provisioned storage pools configured to skip zeroing reused blocks.

items.title: 'We Ported the Original Doom to SQL'
RIP, vector database
items.blurb: turbopuffer is pushing the frontier of search. To do that, we have to fundamentally redesign our storage architecture so the vector index is no longer primary.
